en.topic_title: Western brands under pressure as ‘pre-owned’ luxury booms in China
en.topic_summary:
By Emily Wang



With China’s economy still struggling to recover from the pandemic, even global fashion icons are beginning to feel the pinch as consumers turn instead to the second-hand market or buy upstart new homegrown brands.
